lede: Antz Automobile is a car workshop at Premier@Kaki Bukit, its east service centre. Its own website says it has specialised in Peugeot, Citroën and Opel cars since 2013, and also welcomes Japanese and Korean cars.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention deep knowledge of Peugeot and Citroën cars, on-the-spot troubleshooting, being upfront about risks, and a thorough check that found a failing BPGA battery control unit behind electrical and starting faults.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
